clips.title: The story
paras: Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Amethyst Phial to travelers in Dolanaar. They carry it to the Oracle Glade to gather water from the moonwell beneath the Oracle Tree.

Corithras Moonrage entrusts the Amethyst Phial to travelers on Teldrassil. It is the final vessel used in the Crown of the Earth pilgrimage. They carry it to the far northwest of the boughs, to the Oracle Glade. Beneath the ancient canopy of the Oracle Tree lies the island’s first and most potent moonwell. The phial is dipped into its radiant waters to gather the essence of Elune’s grace. Druids and priestesses study and tend to the World Tree’s unpredictable growth with that water.
